purpose: Bounded timeFit and place-hours checks against the ordinary country plan.

cases.opening: A charcoal mound has to be watched all night, every night of the burn, or it flares and the whole charge is ash. The two burners on tonight have a pot on the fire and a spare log to sit on, and they're glad of a third. "Stay and watch," says the older one. "We'll tell you about the wood."

{&The Drovers' Inn has one long table, one fire and one rule, which nobody can remember. Drovers, tinkers and a man with a bear on a rope share it with whoever comes in.|Market night at the Drovers'. The long table is three to a seat, the fire roars and two drovers are arm-wrestling for the last of the stew.|A wet night at the Drovers'. Steam rises off every coat at the long table, and a tinker by the fire is singing a song with far too many verses.}

The man with the bear has fallen asleep by the fire, and the bear's rope has come undone, and the bear has decided to see what's in the kitchen. The long table empties onto the benches. The landlord is up on the bar with a ladle. The bear stops in the middle of the room and looks at you, because you're the only one not shouting.

The valley says the quarry's echo is full of opinions, and a shepherd boy on the rim dares you to try it. "Good morning," you call. "Is it?" says the quarry. You call that you're from the academy. "Oh," says the quarry, "one of those." The shepherd boy is lying on the grass, helpless.
